arms.A: TF-IDF text similarity over incidents with a scam tactic label
arms.B: components over exact-identifier links (counter-evidence not applied)
arms.C: B after the counter-evidence engine (CE-1,2,3,4,5,7; CE-6 and CE-8 not implemented)

ground_truths.b: true pair = same script family (digital_arrest = T1+T2+T3, bank_kyc = T4, payment_link = T5, courier_customs = T6)

slices.test: the test-split incidents only (T3, T6, N5, N6, D3, D4)

caveat: All data is synthetic and the generator, lexicon and rules share an author, so these numbers describe behaviour on this generator and do not imply real-world performance.
